start:
A small town, already alive.

Residents go to work, then visit a park or market before returning home.

Try adding homes along the main street. Add jobs as the town grows, and leave quiet corners for parks.

Click a resident to see their destination and route.
controls: Click a resident or place to observe   ·   Space: pause   ·   F8: save a feedback marker
build_controls: Click an empty plot to build   ·   Escape: observe   ·   Red ! means no street connection
map_caption: The road on the left connects to the outside world. Residents choose their own daily routes.
empty_desc: A little room for the town to grow.
road_desc: People walk along connected streets. Buildings need a street beside them.
home_desc: Four residents can live here. Happy households expand from day four onward. Nearby workshops reduce wellbeing.
workshop_desc: Eight jobs. Workshops provide income but disturb homes within two blocks.
market_desc: Four jobs and a place to spend free time. Regular visits can turn it into an evening market.
park_desc: A quiet place to relax. Regular visitors eventually create a neighborhood gathering place.

identity_hint: A local tradition develops after 18 visits.
festival_short: Gathering place: visitors gain 5 extra wellbeing.
night_market_short: Evening market: six jobs and extra visitor income.
